title: Payroll portal sign-in: a brute-force lockout that can be sidestepped
name: Payroll login lockout

questions.prompt: Security monitoring flagged hundreds of failed sign-ins against a single payroll account in an hour, yet the account was never locked. The attempts used the same username typed with different capitalisation ("Dana.Reyes", "DANA.REYES", ...). Fix login.ts so the tests pass.
